title: Early piano lessons and a musical family
summary: Back at the start: six or twelve piano lessons, a mother who played trumpet in a girls' band, and a father who chorded and sang.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
